up: Return the exact activity values and canonical SMILES for all compound records tested in assay CHEMBL4513221. Include the molecule ChEMBL ID and compound name for reference. Preserve row multiplicity (one row per activity record). Do not filter by activity type, units, or relation.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513221';
